reason: dsh-git manages agent conversation history as a Git-like graph, allowing users to branch, select, reorder, merge, persist, and inspect completed conversation turns.

summaries.zh: 将智能体对话历史组织为类似 Git 的图结构，支持分支、选择与重排对话轮次、合并上下文以及查看会话和工作区历史。
summaries.en: Organizes agent conversation history as a Git-like graph with branching, turn selection and reordering, context merging, and session or workspace history views.

capabilities: Reads completed conversation turns and session metadata
Persists conversation graph, branch, selection, and preview state in host-managed storage
Creates new agent sessions from selected and reordered conversation turns
Provides graph, timeline, branch switching, and context selection interfaces
Uses a host connection RPC to load workspace conversation graph data
